title: Training-Free Generative Sampling via Moment-Matched Score Smoothing
abstract: arXiv:2605.14276v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion models generate samples by denoising along the score of a perturbed target distribution. In practice, one trains a neural diffusion model, which is computationally expensive. Recent work suggests that score matching implicitly smooths the empirical score, and that this smoothing bias promotes generalization by capturing low-dimensional data geometry. We propose moment-matched score-smoothed overdamped Langevin dynamics (MM-SOLD), a training-free interacting particle sampler that enforces the target moments throughout the sampling trajectory. We prove that the one-particle marginal of the ideal constrained Gibbs equilibrium converges, as the number of particles grows, to a Gibbs--Boltzmann density obtained by exponentially tilting the naive score-smoothed target. translated_title: 通过矩匹配分数平滑实现免训练生成式采样
translated_abstract: 扩散模型通过沿扰动目标分布的分数进行去噪来生成样本。在实践中，需要训练一个神经扩散模型，这在计算上代价高昂。近期研究表明，分数匹配会隐式地平滑经验分数，而这种平滑偏差通过捕捉低维数据几何结构来促进泛化。我们提出了矩匹配分数平滑过阻尼朗之万动力学（MM-SOLD），这是一种免训练的交互粒子采样器，可在整个采样轨迹中强制执行目标矩。我们证明，随着粒子数量的增长，理想约束吉布斯平衡的单粒子边缘分布收敛到通过对朴素分数平滑目标进行指数倾斜而得到的吉布斯-玻尔兹曼密度。其均值和协方差与训练所用的GMM相匹配，即使对于秩亏数据也是如此。我们还建立了采样一致性以及针对目标分布的统计误差界（摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种免训练的交互粒子采样器MM-SOLD，通过在整个采样轨迹中强制匹配目标矩，从理论上证明其收敛到与训练GMM均值和协方差一致的吉布斯-玻尔兹曼分布，即使数据秩亏也成立。
en_tdlr: MM-SOLD is a training-free interacting particle sampler that enforces target moments throughout sampling, provably converging to a Gibbs–Boltzmann density whose mean and covariance match the training GMM even for rank-deficient data.
